sloka: स रामो बहुभिः बाणैः खर कार्मुक निःसृतैः ।विद्धो रुधिर सिक्तांगो बभूव रुषितो भृशम् ॥३-२८-२५॥
transliteration: sa rāmo bahubhiḥ bāṇaiḥ khara kārmuka niḥsṛtaiḥ ।viddho rudhira siktāṁgo babhūva ruṣito bhṛśam ॥3-28-25॥

translations.english: Rama, hit by the arrows released from the bow of Khara, all his limbs drenched in blood, became very furious.
